bio: My name is Killian Kaffa and welcome to my page! Take a good look to get to know me better. Since I was a kid I have been very interested in coding and working with online programs. In addition to that, I am very active. The thing I like the most about programming is the front-end. That is why I also chose digital signage as my minor. I am also very active on social media, click on the icons to check out some of my social media accounts.
some: Here are some of my skills and hobbies.
pollepel: In the assignment 'De Pollepel' I had to make a website for a cooking club for the profession. In this project I was given the task of creating and designing the index page.
corfu: This project is also from the subject 'beroeps'. Here we had to create a website for an existing restaurant with a group of three. We chose the Greek restaurant called Corfu.
wireframe: These wireframes I made for the subject 'proces' is for a comic book collector. I am very satisfied with the end result of these designs.
tlou: This is a quiz I made about one of my favorite video games 'The Last of Us'.
social media: In my free time I spend a lot of time on social media. I also post a lot on instagram myself and have collaborations with various companies. Among others: Desenio, Divain Perfumes, Kidsbrandstore & bond-touch.
